breadcrumb.label: The Office of the Royal Society holds a ceremony to offer blessings on the auspicious occasion of the 4th Cycle Birthday Anniversary of Her Majesty Queen Suthida Bajrasudhabimalalakshana, 3 June 2026

paragraphs: On 4 June 2026 at 3:00 p.m., at the 2nd-floor hall of the Office of the Royal Society, The Government Complex Commemorating His Majesty the King's 80th Birthday Anniversary, 5th December B.E. 2550, Dr. Supharoek Phuphongsak, Secretary-General of the Royal Society, presided over the unveiling of the floral offering and delivered words of blessing, and signed birthday blessings before the portrait of Her Majesty the Queen on the auspicious occasion of the 4th Cycle Birthday Anniversary of Her Majesty Queen Suthida Bajrasudhabimalalakshana, 3 June 2026, with executives, civil servants and personnel of the Office of the Royal Society attending in unison
